title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Lumen Parcel runs same-day delivery in six European cities. We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to own our dbt project on BigQuery and the Looker layer used by operations.

You will: build and test dbt models for deliveries, couriers and customer support; work with operations managers to define metrics; review pull requests from analysts.

Requirements: 3+ years writing production SQL; hands-on dbt experience including tests; experience with a BI tool such as Looker; fluent written English.
Nice to have: logistics or delivery data; Python; Airflow.

Remote within Europe. Questions? Write to [email removed].

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Faro Health builds appointment software for private clinics in Spain. As Senior Data Analyst you will lead reporting for the commercial and clinic-success teams.

Requirements: 5+ years in data analysis; advanced SQL; Python for analysis; experience presenting to non-technical stakeholders; Spanish and English.
Nice to have: healthcare data; dbt; mentoring experience.

Remote from Spain, one day a month in Madrid.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Kestrel Payments processes card payments for small shops. We need a Data Engineer for our streaming platform.

Requirements: 4+ years building streaming pipelines with Kafka and Spark; strong Scala or Java; experience with Kubernetes; on-call rotation.
Nice to have: payments domain; dbt.

Remote in Europe.

title: BI Developer
description:

Requirements: 3+ years with Power BI and SQL; experience with high-volume event data.

Hybrid in Valencia or remote in Spain.

title: Analytics Engineer

title: Head of Data
description:

Remote worldwide.
